contributions.detail: 60 Form A rows over three sheets: p15 25 rows = 25,221.37, p16 30 rows = 27,418.08, p17 5 rows = 6,000.00; 25,221.37 + 27,418.08 + 6,000.00 = 58,639.45, to the cent, against the schedule's own grand total printed on the last sheet (the sheets carry NO per-page subtotal, so the multi-sheet sum against that grand total is the gate). The 2016 cover is the 3-LINE variant: one 'Total contributions from all donors' cell, no separate <=$50 aggregate line, so the anchor is contrib_all and there is no line-1/line-2 residual. The cover's 'Totals from Last Report' column is BLANK, so this report restates the whole cycle and exact (not period-exact) is the right verdict.

expenditures.anchor: Form B's own printed 'Total Expenditures: (to line 2 of report)' = 56,420.94 on p21, which equals BOTH the cover's 'Totals for This Report' and its 'Cumulative Totals' cell for line 2 (56,420.94)
expenditures.detail: 101 Form B rows over four sheets: p18 25 rows = 12,156.14, p19 30 rows = 10,726.26, p20 30 rows = 24,871.59, p21 16 rows = 8,666.95; the four sum to 56,420.94, to the cent, against the schedule's grand total on the last sheet (no per-page subtotals are printed). The p18 row-25 Walmart refund is inside that sum as a NEGATIVE (56.20); with it positive the sheets over-run the printed total by 112.40, which is the arithmetic proof that the filer's parentheses mean a credit. The cover's ending balance closes the same way: 58,639.45 - 56,420.94 = 2,218.51, the printed line-3 figure.

itemized.notes: Eight-page filing: p14 cover, Form A (Itemized Report of Contributions) on p15-p17, Form B (Itemized Report of Expenditures) on p18-p21. Both schedules are ROTATED landscape sheets. Donor STREET addresses are printed on Form A and are deliberately NOT carried into this record (PRIVACY.md: donor_city / donor_state only). Where donor_state is blank the FILER printed no state (city + ZIP only, or a bare city) - nothing here was redacted by the county on these pages. Form B has no address column at all, only a City column, which is recorded in each expenditure row's note. This is an OFFICEHOLDER-era account but the cover's 'Totals from Last Report' column is BLANK on this filing, so the schedules are cycle-scoped, not period-scoped. index.csv also carries a standalone Wayback copy of this same 2016-10-31 filing (document_id wb20190828041319_harvey_commission) - two channels, ONE report; a rollup must count it once. The filer's own in-kind double entries (The Vacguy.com supplies/sign donations, Jones Shirts & Signs merchandise donations) appear on both schedules and are counted on both sides, as the form instructs.
